items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: Remember him? Yeah, he was drunk, Red Duguay.

ctx.x: Remember him? Yeah, he was drunk, Red Duguay. Was he left-handed?

No, he wasn't left-handed. I knew one other drummer in Chicago was left-handed, Snaggs. Clifford Jones was his name. He came from here, but he went up there when he was pretty young. They called him Snaggs. He played with Joe Oliver and some of the people there. Did you ever play with Joe Oliver?
